facts.text: Dual Facsimile Cameras was deployed at Utopia Planitia during Viking 2 in 1976.
Twin vertical scanning cameras that used nodding mirrors and silicon photodiode arrays to sweep line-by-line 360-degree high-resolution panoramic images in monochrome, color, and infrared spectrums.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
Captured the famous frost panoramas showing water ice crystallizing on Martian rocks and dust dunes across 100 consecutive sols in the Utopia winter.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Utopia Planitia.
Proved that water frost naturally occurs on the surface of Mars, transforming our understanding of Martian volatiles.
